Tara (Customer Success): FYI — NovaMed AP is blocking our invoice. Their procurement says they must receive an official PO in the exact format `NM-PO-YYYY-#####` and a 6-digit cost center. They returned our draft with comments. Ticket: support-98321 https://support.internal/tickets/98321 :no_entry_sign:

NovaMed AP: We cannot process invoices unless the PO number follows our internal pattern and matches the supplier record (company name and VAT). Please resubmit with order_number=NM-PO-2026-01234, cost_center=223411, and VAT DE123456789. Our SAP upload fails otherwise.

Bob (Finance): Do we have anything preventing us from issuing an invoice once they provide that PO? Our invoicing system expects a freeform reference, but some customers require the PO in a specific `order_number` field for their SAP. Is this a hard AP requirement or just a preference?

Tara (Customer Success): Procurement marked it as 'AP policy — do not pay' until fields match. They also asked that the legal name on the invoice exactly match their vendor record: "NovaMed Labs Ltd." The draft PO they attached is unsigned.

Jane (Accounting): We can include those fields, but we need a signed PO pdf to attach. Also need the remittance email or address to deliver the invoice. If they insist on PO before invoice, we can generate a proforma, but note: some customers won't accept proforma as a substitute.

BillingBot: Invoice generation failed for ticket support-98321: missing required field `order_number`. (error code: INV_MISSING_ORDER_NUMBER)

Bob (Finance): OK — action items: sales needs to get the signed PO with the exact `order_number` format and cost center. Once we have that, accounting can re-run invoice generator and attach the PO. If NovaMed absolutely refuses invoice-first workflows, we'll mark the account on billing_hold.

Emma (Legal): Per our SOW clause 3.2 we are allowed to invoice based on delivered service without prior PO, but we should accommodate enterprise AP workflows when feasible to avoid payment delays. If Sales can secure a signed PO that matches the company legal name and VAT, we should be fine. If they insist on a different remittance entity, we might need an amendment.

Michael (Sales): I'll reach out to their buyer now (cc'd). Tara — can you paste the attached draft PO here or drop the pdf link? I'll ask for the exact `order_number` pattern and confirmation of cost_center and remittance details.

Tara (Customer Success): Dropping the link to the draft PO: https://files.internal/po_drafts/novamed_98321_draft.pdf. They commented: "SAP validation failed — order_number mismatch; no VAT on supplier record."

NovaMed AP: Confirming we need VAT DE123456789 and supplier name exactly "NovaMed Labs Ltd". We will attach the uploaded PO to our SAP once it matches.

Jane (Accounting): When Sales gets the signed PO, please ensure it includes: 1) order_number in `NM-PO-YYYY-#####` format, 2) cost_center (6 digits), 3) supplier VAT / tax ID and legal name, and 4) remittance email. We can do a quick test upload to our billing system internally before issuing final invoice.

Bob (Finance): I'll prepare a temporary billing_hold flag and a note in the customer ledger so we don't auto-send any invoices until we get the corrected PO.

Emma (Legal): If they push for an amendment to change billing entity or remittance instructions, route the request to me and include their legal contact.

Michael (Sales): Pinged buyer — asking for signed PO with exact fields. ETA end of day. :eyes:

Tara (Customer Success): Thanks — I'll update the ticket and set priority=high. If they don't respond by EOD tomorrow, we'll escalate to AM. :thumbsup:

Jane (Accounting): Noted. Will hold on invoicing and prepare to reissue once PO is received.

Bob (Finance): Thanks team. I'll update internal billing ticket: BILL-4472 and set a follow-up for 48h.

Tara (Customer Success): Closing loop here — will paste NovaMed reply into support-98321 when it arrives.
